id: 30_Significance of lab hazard in terms of sterilization, laboratory hazard steriliz
title: 实验室危害与灭菌
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/30_Significance of lab hazard in terms of sterilization, laboratory hazard steriliz.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/30_Significance of lab hazard in terms of sterilization, laboratory hazard steriliz/src.py

points.K3: 危险物料，正确处理处置
points.K4: 热、化学品、辐射用来灭菌
points.K8: 灭菌设备，维护不当会出事
points.K10: 操作灭菌设备，穿戴防护

shots.scene: 欣欣站在灭菌间门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a sterilization room with an autoclave behind it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到实验室安全课。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现火焰、试剂瓶、射线三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Beside the panda mascot float three icons: a flame, a reagent bottle, and radiating rays.
shots.narration: 今天说说灭菌和危害的关系。

shots.scene: 阿杰抱着一摞用过的培养皿走向灭菌间
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a stack of used culture dishes toward the sterilization room.

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a question mark above him.
shots.narration: 他想：灭菌是杀菌的，能有啥危险？

shots.scene: 小研指着冒热气的灭菌器和一瓶消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points to an autoclave releasing steam and a bottle of disinfectant on a shelf.
shots.narration: 小研说：杀菌的手段，本身就是危害。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一块分成七格的空白板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank board divided into seven squares, each with a small icon.

shots.scene: 天平两端：一边病菌，一边火焰和试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with germ icons on one side and a flame and a reagent bottle on the other. No people.

shots.scene: 火焰和试剂瓶同时指向病菌和人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A flame and a reagent bottle point arrows both at germ icons and at a person outline. No people.
shots.narration: 用的却是同样能伤人的东西。

shots.scene: 干净的工作台上落下几颗病菌
shots.prompt_en: A few germ icons drift down onto a clean, empty lab bench. No people.

shots.scene: 台面、仪器、培养基三个图标被病菌覆盖
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a bench top, an instrument and a medium bottle, become covered with small germ icons. No people.

shots.scene: 培养皿长满杂菌，旁边红叉
shots.prompt_en: A culture dish overgrown with stray colonies, with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 台面、设备和材料就不再无菌。

shots.section_title: 危险物料，正确处理处置
shots.scene: 小研戴手套把用过的培养皿放进带生物危害标志的袋子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, places used culture dishes into a bag with a biohazard sign.
shots.narration: 用过的东西，收进专用袋，
overlay: 危险物料，正确处理处置

shots.section_title: 危险物料，正确处理处置
shots.scene: 小研用消毒剂擦拭台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the bench top with disinfectant and paper towels.

shots.section_title: 危险物料，正确处理处置
shots.scene: 袋子放进灭菌器旁的转运箱
shots.prompt_en: The bag is placed into a closed transfer box beside the autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 处理和处置得当，才能防污染。

shots.section_title: 热、化学品、辐射用来灭菌
shots.scene: 三个图标：蒸汽、试剂瓶、射线
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: rising steam, a chemical bottle, and radiating rays. No people.
overlay: 热、化学品、辐射用来灭菌

shots.section_title: 热、化学品、辐射用来灭菌
shots.scene: 三个图标的箭头射向病菌，病菌消失
shots.prompt_en: Arrows from the steam, the bottle and the rays hit germ icons, which disappear. No people.
shots.narration: 热、化学品、辐射，都能杀灭微生物。

shots.scene: 蒸汽烫到手的图标、试剂熏到鼻的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of steam scalding a hand and fumes reaching a nose, each with a red exclamation mark. No people.

shots.scene: 人形图标和河流图标同时变红
shots.prompt_en: A person outline and a river icon both turn red. No people.

shots.scene: 高温、毒性、辐射三个警示标志
shots.prompt_en: Three warning signs: a hot surface warning sign, a toxic hazard pictogram, and an ionizing radiation warning sign. No people.

shots.scene: 灭菌器旁挂着一张空白操作规程卡
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure card hangs on the wall next to an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 高温、毒物、射线，都要按规程来。

shots.scene: 盾牌护着人形图标，旁边一个对勾的培养皿
shots.prompt_en: A shield protects a person outline; next to it, a clean culture dish with a green check mark. No people.

shots.scene: 阿杰按空白规程卡逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student ticks off items on a blank procedure card in front of the autoclave.
shots.narration: 保护操作的人，也保证灭得干净。

shots.section_title: 灭菌设备，维护不当会出事
shots.scene: 老李打开灭菌器侧板检查
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the side panel of an autoclave for inspection.
overlay: 灭菌设备，维护不当会出事

shots.section_title: 灭菌设备，维护不当会出事
shots.scene: 灭菌器漏汽、密封圈开裂的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an autoclave leaking steam from its door and a cracked door gasket, with red exclamation marks. No people.

shots.section_title: 灭菌设备，维护不当会出事
shots.scene: 设备冒烟，警示灯闪红
shots.prompt_en: A machine with a flashing red indicator and a puff of smoke. No people.

shots.scene: 日历上每月一个对勾和扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a check mark on each month next to a wrench icon. No people.

shots.scene: 老李对着温度计和压力表校准，记在空白记录本上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a thermometer and a gauge against a reference and writes in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 仪表定期校准，留下记录。

shots.section_title: 操作灭菌设备，穿戴防护
shots.scene: 隔热手套、护目镜、实验服三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: heat-resistant gloves, safety goggles, and a lab coat. No people.
overlay: 操作灭菌设备，穿戴防护

shots.section_title: 操作灭菌设备，穿戴防护
shots.scene: 小研穿好实验服、戴上隔热手套和护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a lab coat, heat-resistant gloves and safety goggles in front of the autoclave.
shots.narration: 装取物品、配消毒剂前，先穿戴好，

shots.section_title: 操作灭菌设备，穿戴防护
shots.scene: 蒸汽和液滴被护目镜和手套挡住
shots.prompt_en: Steam and droplets bounce off goggles and gloves drawn as simple icons. No people.

shots.scene: 水滴图标里有几颗病菌和化学品小瓶
shots.prompt_en: A large water droplet icon containing a few germ icons and a small chemical bottle. No people.

shots.scene: 化学灭菌剂流向河流，鱼变灰
shots.prompt_en: Chemical sterilant flowing from a drain toward a river where the fish turn grey. No people.
shots.narration: 化学灭菌剂、辐射管理不好，会伤环境。

shots.scene: 灭菌后剩下的废液、废料和用过的耗材图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of leftover sterilant liquid, spent materials and used consumables after sterilization. No people.

shots.scene: 小研把灭菌后的废料分类放进不同的收集容器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sorts the leftovers from sterilization into separate closed collection containers.

shots.scene: 河流图标恢复清澈，鱼儿游动
shots.prompt_en: A river icon turns clear again with fish swimming in it. No people.
shots.narration: 就能减少对环境的影响。

shots.scene: 灭菌器里塞得太满的物品图标
shots.prompt_en: An autoclave chamber packed too tightly with items, with a red exclamation mark. No people.

shots.scene: 灭菌后的培养基仍长出菌落
shots.prompt_en: A medium bottle taken out after sterilization still shows growing colonies. No people.
shots.narration: 装得乱、设备有毛病，灭菌就不彻底。

shots.scene: 灭菌包上的空白指示条变了颜色
shots.prompt_en: A blank indicator strip on a sterilization pack changes color. No people.

shots.scene: 老李把结果写进空白记录表并签名
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer writes results into a blank record sheet and signs it.

shots.scene: 绿色对勾盖在灭菌器图标上
shots.prompt_en: A large green check mark appears over an autoclave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 确保真正把微生物灭干净。

shots.scene: 七格板逐格亮起
shots.prompt_en: The seven-square board lights up square by square. No people.

shots.scene: 七格板后四格高亮
shots.prompt_en: The last four squares of the board are highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 勤维护、戴防护、护环境、做验证。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴好防护，按规程把物品放进灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing heat-resistant gloves and goggles, loads items into the autoclave following a blank procedure card.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：灭菌也得讲安全！

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在灭菌间门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the female graduate student wave goodbye at the sterilization room door.
shots.narration: 灭得干净，做得安全，下次见！
